authority_policy: Official Games Workshop exact rules text > official summary/article > current secondary structured source > historical local snapshot.

items.official_summary: The July 22 official update article states that slain Characters returning to battle return on their own as a unit of one.
items.secondary_observation: The current structured core page contains attachment-return wording whose scope can appear narrower/different for Leader/Support models.
items.reason: The two statements may apply to different destruction/return states. Exact official Universal Rules Update wording is required before a universal executable rule is certified.
items.resolution: The June Core Rules wording is older. The official July 22 update explicitly changes revived slain Characters to return separately as a unit of one. Newer official update overrides June core wording.
